title: TimeLabels
description: Short, deterministic date/time labels for Swift UIs — 'In 2h', '5mins ago', '3:30 PM', 'Tomorrow'.
why: Turn raw Dates into the short strings a UI needs without duplicating DateFormatter setup across screens. Covers countdowns (timeRemaining), elapsed time (timeAgo), automatic direction (relative), durations ('1h 30m' or '1:30:00'), clock times, and dates like 'Tomorrow at 3:30 PM'. Configurable units, rounding, and spelling, with Date extensions and a self-updating SwiftUI TimeLabelText. Thread-safe with no shared mutable state, fixed en_US_POSIX locale and Gregorian calendar for consistent output, and a now: parameter for testing. Installs via Swift Package Manager (2.0.0+) under the MIT license.
stack: Swift 6.0+, SwiftUI — iOS 16+, macOS 13+, watchOS 9+, tvOS 16+, visionOS 1+ (tested on Linux in CI)
